## What it is
rag-shared is a shared utility library for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) orchestration services. It provides logging, observability, and caching capabilities to support RAG workflows.

## Current capabilities
- Readable Logging: Milvus-style format easy to read in terminals and Grafana
- OpenTelemetry Observability: Distributed tracing with OTLP export (optional)
- Dragonfly/Redis Client: Cache client for inter-service data sharing
